import numpy as np


def q398(target_probs, draft_probs, prompt, steps, draft_length, seed=0):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    tokens = list(prompt)
    for _ in range(steps):
        drafts = []
        qs = []
        prefix = tokens.copy()
        for _ in range(draft_length):
            q = np.asarray(draft_probs(prefix), float)
            token = int(rng.choice(len(q), p=q))
            drafts.append(token)
            qs.append(q)
            prefix.append(token)
        rejected = False
        for token, q in zip(drafts, qs):
            p = np.asarray(target_probs(tokens), float)
            if rng.random() < min(1.0, p[token] / q[token]):
                tokens.append(token)
            else:
                residual = np.maximum(p - q, 0)
                residual /= residual.sum()
                tokens.append(int(rng.choice(len(p), p=residual)))
                rejected = True
                break
        if not rejected:
            p = np.asarray(target_probs(tokens), float)
            tokens.append(int(rng.choice(len(p), p=p)))
    return tokens
